realizes.rationale: Restores the captured subject and family context through the page-provided selection adapter. ReviewSurface supplies keepTree=false for that adapter, so marker return starts the walk afresh; restore then clears tree focus and restores worklist.
Names the followed invariant and optional family context, then calls the supplied selection adapter. ReviewSurface supplies that adapter with keepTree=false, so marker entry starts the walk afresh.
Keeps marker origin/return in review navigation rather than creating browser-history subject selections that reset the walk.

Captures subject, chosen family and worklist. Restore selects subject/context first, clears the tree-focus request, then sets worklist; no opened-file, layout or Full file state is captured or reconstructed.
